question: Should `/workspace` become a supported runtime-container alias, or remain reserved for sandbox containers while runtime documentation consistently uses `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace`?
rationale: Both paths already carry product meaning: the published Docker persistence contract uses the home-directory path, while sandbox behavior uses `/workspace`; implementation requires choosing the permanent user-facing boundary.

options.title: Support a runtime alias
options.body: Add and test `/workspace` as an alias for the persisted runtime workspace across all first-party container launch paths, while keeping sandbox host-bind translation out of scope.

options.title: Keep paths distinct
options.body: Keep `/workspace` sandbox-only and revise agent/runtime documentation that implies it exists in gateway or CLI containers.

options.title: Defer to sandbox work
options.body: Resolve the broader Docker-outside-of-Docker workspace mapping first, then decide whether a runtime alias remains useful.

recommendation.title: Support a runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add and test `/workspace` as an alias for the persisted runtime workspace across all first-party container launch paths, while keeping sandbox host-bind translation out of scope.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior issue review and the available history connect this person to both sides of the runtime-versus-sandbox path contract.
